name: Apple Music with Timbre
subtitle: Apple Music player and Timbre audio tools
description: Version 0.2.0 adds Home recommendations, Browse charts, Radio station discovery, album and playlist track pages, expanded search and Now Playing queue with skip, shuffle and repeat. No subscription is assumed for station requests; Apple controls radio eligibility. Timbre EQ applies to imported unprotected audio only. Device playback and iOS 27 layout are unverified.
